about: Two outputs on one node, both with PowerOnBehaviour = RESTORE: each keeps its OWN state in the persistent store, under a key carrying its endpoint number. With one shared key every output restored the state of whichever switched last (zadania/zrobione/FEAT-02.md, F4). Invert off, so the driven level is the state.

steps.note: each output restored from its own key
Toggle ep5 -> on; ep4 keeps its stored state
this module has Invert (the receiver on the normally-closed contact); a bool takes 0 or 1
